input.quote: 22.1 Vendor may audit Customer's compliance with licence quantities no more than once in any twelve-month period, on at least thirty days' prior written notice, during normal business hours, and in a manner that does not unreasonably disrupt Customer. An audit will be conducted off-site where practicable by an independent auditor bound by confidentiality.
input.rationale: Section 22 is the only audit/verification right binding us (Section 23 is a bare heading with no operative text, and no other inspection right appears in the document). It meets the preferred position on every material term: frequency limited to once per twelve months (§22.1), thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and an independent auditor bound by confidentiality. Costs sit with Vendor unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent (§22.2), and direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and other suppliers' confidential information is expressly barred. Section 22.3 additionally protects us by making findings our Confidential Information. No redline required.
